Title: Power BI Embedded tile embedding enhancements

Body.Content:
Power BI Embedded has added support for more tile types that can be embedded. Here are the additional tile types:

  • Live page tiles
  • Custom visual tiles
  • R visual tiles
  • Live stream tiles
  • Image tiles
  • Video tiles
  • Web content tiles
  • Q&A tiles
  • Visio tiles

To read more, see the wiki entry about tile embedding.
